notices.text: Copyright IBM Corp. 2018, 2026 (token/type source files); Copyright IBM Corp. 2016, 2026 (button/_mixins.scss and text-input/_text-input.scss); Copyright IBM Corp. 2016, 2023 (button variables); Copyright IBM Corp. 2021 (box-shadow utility). Modified by Monet: selected and renamed records, resolved color aliases, converted mini-units, mapped the 4px card radius, selected the non-v12 text-input branch, condensed guidance, and flattened White/Gray 100 into modes. No upstream NOTICE file was present in the inspected Carbon and Carbon website source trees.

omissions: White and Gray 100 are flattened into Profile modes; alternate Gray 10/90 configurations are omitted.
One layer context is selected. Recursive layer switching and dynamic theme algorithms are not represented.
IBM Plex family references retain upstream fallbacks; font binaries are not included, so installed fonts affect appearance.
No components, icons, pictograms, brand assets or runtime accessibility behavior are bundled.
Productive fixed typography is selected; expressive/fluid type, full responsive grids and motion choreography remain references.
Only five component decisions and two compositions are included.

Inherited light-mode link and error text on layer 01 each measure about 4.55:1: above the 4.5:1 text floor, below Monet’s 4.75:1 margin. These produce two validation warnings; upstream colors are preserved.

Square text-input and bottom-border guidance assumes enable-v12-release is disabled in the pinned Carbon stylesheet. The enabled branch uses 4px rounding and a full gradient border. radius.card separately follows the documented 4px card default.

principles.title: Use a shared grid
principles.body:
Organize layout with the 2x Grid and its 8px mini-unit. Align repeated content and controls; use the spacing scale to express grouping and separation.

Monet adaptation: Carbon. [source-012](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/elements/2x-grid/overview.mdx)

principles.title: Make the main task clear
principles.body:
Give a screen one principal action, with secondary and tertiary actions used according to their roles. In data views, make the title, toolbar and table structure understandable before adding interaction.

components.rationale: Explicit action hierarchy for productive interfaces.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Carbon: One primary action per screen, with documented exceptions for header/modal/side panel. Secondary is a paired negative action such as Cancel or Back; tertiary can stand alone. Ghost is least prominent; danger variants identify destructive actions. Text labels align left and accompanying icons right.

[source-013](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/button/usage.mdx) [source-015](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/blob/9ccc72cf1d0de422dec37e7d6ae360b64b3457d3/packages/themes/src/dtcg/components/button.json)
use_when: A supported secondary, tertiary, ghost or danger action

components.rationale: Labeled single-line entry with helper and error context.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Carbon: Configuration: enable-v12-release disabled. This selects the square field with a bottom border; the v12-enabled branch uses border-radius-04 and a full gradient border. Keep a visible label; placeholders are examples, not a label replacement. Show helper text and actionable invalid-state messages. Disabled and read-only states differ.

[source-020](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/text-input/usage.mdx) [source-019](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/blob/9ccc72cf1d0de422dec37e7d6ae360b64b3457d3/packages/styles/scss/components/text-input/_text-input.scss)
use_when: Values not represented by a fixed choice list
avoid_when: Long text requiring a text area

components.rationale: Structured comparison with opt-in row actions.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Carbon: Provide a descriptive title and column headers. Add toolbar/search, selection, sorting, expandable rows or pagination only when the task needs them. Batch actions apply to selected rows. Choose an appropriate documented row size; no universal density is imposed by this decision.

[source-014](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/data-table/usage.mdx)

components.rationale: An interruption for a short, focused task.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Carbon: Choose passive, transactional or danger modals according to the task. Provide a clear heading and closing behavior, preserve focus, and use modals for short, non-frequent tasks.

[source-021](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/modal/usage.mdx)

components.rationale: Status or feedback delivered with appropriate urgency.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Carbon: Use inline feedback in task context; choose a toast only for suitable transient communication. Provide meaningful text as well as status color/icon. Avoid unnecessary interruptions or multiple competing notifications.

[source-022](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/notification/usage.mdx)

patterns.title: Data table actions
patterns.summary: Coordinate a table, toolbar and action feedback.
patterns.body:
Monet adaptation of Carbon guidance.

Name the data set and its columns. Add selection and batch actions only for a real multi-record task, distinguish toolbar actions from row actions, and communicate the result using appropriate notification feedback. Preserve row context and do not make all actions visually primary.

Sources: [source-014](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/data-table/usage.mdx) [source-013](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/button/usage.mdx) [source-022](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/notification/usage.mdx)

patterns.title: Transactional dialog
patterns.summary: Keep a focused transaction brief and understandable.
patterns.body:
Monet adaptation composition using Carbon guidance.

Use a transactional modal for a short operation. Give inputs visible labels and actionable errors. Pair the primary and cancel actions in the documented modal arrangement. Use the danger treatment for destructive or irreversible actions.

Sources: [source-021](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/modal/usage.mdx) [source-020](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/text-input/usage.mdx) [source-013](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-website/blob/ea81028857791c9bc5004ee9ae6e82e3e654dfc3/src/pages/components/button/usage.mdx)
